evals.prompt: Check the Availability Zones in `ap-south-1` on our live AWS account (read-only), and design a production 3-AZ, 3-tier dual-stack (IPv4 + IPv6) VPC blueprint (`10.40.0.0/16`) with Public, Private Application, and Isolated Database subnets, VPC Flow Logs, and mandatory free Gateway VPC Endpoints.
expectations: Activates the aws-networking-and-compute skill and queries `ap-south-1` Availability Zones (`ap-south-1a`, `ap-south-1b`, `ap-south-1c`) via connected AWS MCP tools with zero raw `aws` CLI shell commands
Allocates non-overlapping CIDR ranges across all 3 AZs for Public (ALB/NAT), Private App (EKS/ECS/Lambda), and Isolated Data (RDS/ElastiCache with zero route to IGW or NAT)
Includes IPv6 `/56` VPC block (`assign_generated_ipv6_cidr_block` + `/64` subnets with Egress-Only IGW for outbound IPv6), VPC Flow Logs, and free S3 + DynamoDB Gateway VPC Endpoints

evals.prompt: Design a production Amazon ECS Fargate service blueprint behind an HTTPS Application Load Balancer (`awsvpc` networking) for a stateless Node.js API, covering ALB-to-Task security group chaining, Graviton (`ARM64`), health check grace periods, and graceful `SIGTERM` connection draining.
expectations: Activates the aws-networking-and-compute skill
Configures `awsvpc` tasks in Private App subnets (with `assignPublicIp = DISABLED`), chaining the Task Security Group ingress strictly from the ALB Security Group ID (never `0.0.0.0/0`)
Includes `ARM64` (`runtimePlatform`) Graviton sizing, `healthCheckGracePeriodSeconds`, and ALB `deregistration_delay` aligned with ECS `stopTimeout` for zero-dropped-request `SIGTERM` draining

evals.prompt: What are the non-negotiable IaC architecture standards when provisioning a production Amazon EKS cluster in Terraform or CDK across control-plane access, pod IAM authentication, VPC CNI IP exhaustion prevention, and node autoscaling?
expectations: Activates the aws-networking-and-compute skill

Recommends private (or CIDR-restricted public+private) EKS API endpoint with `API_AND_CONFIG_MAP` authentication mode (`AccessEntry` APIs instead of manual `aws-auth` ConfigMap edits) and **EKS Pod Identity** (`eks-pod-identity-agent`) / IRSA

Addresses VPC CNI IP exhaustion (Prefix Delegation `ENABLE_PREFIX_DELEGATION=true`, dedicated secondary `/16` pod CIDRs, or IPv6 mode) and recommends EKS Auto Mode or Karpenter (`NodePool`/`EC2NodeClass`) over static Cluster Autoscaler node groups

evals.prompt: We are scaling from 2 VPCs to 18 workload VPCs across Dev, Staging, and Prod OUs and VPC Peering has become unmanageable. Design a Hub-and-Spoke AWS Transit Gateway topology with route-table isolation between non-prod and prod, centralized Interface VPC Endpoints (PHZ), and Appliance Mode for stateful inspection.
expectations: Activates the aws-networking-and-compute skill
Replaces full-mesh VPC peering (`N*(N-1)/2`) with AWS Transit Gateway using separate TGW Route Tables (`prod`, `non-prod`, `shared-services`/`inspection`) so Dev cannot route to Prod
Enables `ApplianceModeSupport = enable` on the Inspection/Firewall VPC TGW attachment to preserve AZ symmetry for stateful traffic

Centralizes Interface VPC Endpoints (PrivateLink) in a Shared Services VPC using centralized Route 53 Private Hosted Zones (`private_dns_only_for_inbound_resolver_endpoint` / disabled per-spoke duplicate endpoints)

evals.prompt: Review a proposed serverless IaC stack: API Gateway REST API -> Lambda (`x86_64`, 128 MB RAM, 30s timeout, attached to 1 `/28` private subnet) -> SQS standard queue (`visibility_timeout_seconds = 30`, no DLQ) -> downstream worker Lambda (`timeout = 90s`). Identify every networking, reliability, and performance flaw and provide the corrected IaC blueprint.
expectations: Activates the aws-networking-and-compute skill

Fixes the critical SQS retry storm bug (`visibility_timeout_seconds` MUST be `>= 6x` the consumer Lambda timeout, i.e., `>= 540s` for a `90s` worker) and adds a Dead-Letter Queue (`redrive_policy` with `maxReceiveCount`) + `ReportBatchItemFailures`

Fixes VPC-attached Lambda ENI exhaustion risk (`/28` single-AZ subnet has only 11 usable AWS IPs and zero AZ redundancy — use multi-AZ `/24`+ private subnets, or keep Lambda out of VPC unless accessing private VPC resources) and upgrades to `arm64` Graviton2

evals.prompt: Provide the mandatory IaC production guardrails for stateful storage and databases across (1) S3 general-purpose buckets, (2) EBS volumes attached to stateful instances, and (3) RDS/Aurora clusters.
expectations: Activates the aws-networking-and-compute skill

Covers S3 (`BlockPublicAccess` all 4 flags, `BucketOwnerEnforced` ACLs disabled, SSE-S3/SSE-KMS encryption, `aws:SecureTransport` TLS-only policy, lifecycle `abort_incomplete_multipart_upload`, and versioning)
Covers EBS (`gp3` default over `gp2`, KMS encryption, `DeleteOnTermination: false` for stateful volumes, and DLM snapshot backups)
Covers RDS/Aurora (Isolated DB subnet group, Multi-AZ for prod, `DeletionProtection` enabled, KMS storage encryption, automated backups, and Secrets Manager managed credentials)

evals.prompt: Explain the architectural and routing difference between Gateway VPC Endpoints and Interface VPC Endpoints (AWS PrivateLink) in IaC, and tell us which endpoint type applies to `s3`, `dynamodb`, `ecr.api`/`ecr.dkr`, `logs`, `sts`, and `secretsmanager`.
expectations: Activates the aws-networking-and-compute skill

Contrasts Gateway Endpoints (prefix-list route table entries, $0/hr and $0/GB, supporting **only S3 and DynamoDB** — though S3 also offers Interface Endpoints for on-prem/peered PrivateLink) against Interface Endpoints (ENI + Security Group + Private DNS in subnets, billed hourly per AZ + per GB, used for `ecr.api`, `ecr.dkr`, `logs`, `sts`, `secretsmanager`)
Reminds that ECS/EKS image pulls from ECR without NAT require BOTH `ecr.api` + `ecr.dkr` Interface Endpoints AND the **S3 Gateway Endpoint** (since ECR image layers live in S3!)

evals.prompt: An engineer wants to create 1 S3 bucket per enterprise tenant (2,500 tenants) and shard object keys with random MD5 hex prefixes so S3 doesn't throttle at 100 RPS. Correct any outdated S3 myths and provide the modern multi-tenant S3 architecture in IaC.
expectations: Activates the aws-networking-and-compute skill

Clarifies modern S3 performance and limits (3,500 `PUT`/`COPY`/`POST`/`DELETE` and 5,500 `GET`/`HEAD` requests/second **per partitioned prefix** automatically — manual hex-hash prefixing is no longer needed for normal workloads, while bucket count has account quotas and operational overhead)

Recommends shared multi-tenant bucket(s) isolated via **S3 Access Points** and/or tenant-prefixed ABAC IAM policies (`${aws:PrincipalTag/...}/*`) + SSE-KMS with S3 Bucket Keys instead of creating thousands of per-tenant buckets

evals.prompt: Size EBS storage in Terraform for two workloads: (A) a PostgreSQL instance needing 2 TB storage, 12,000 IOPS, and 500 MB/s throughput, and (B) a mission-critical SAP HANA / Oracle database needing 64,000 IOPS with sub-millisecond latency durability (`99.999%`).
expectations: Activates the aws-networking-and-compute skill

Maps Workload (A) to `gp3` (`size = 2048`, `iops = 12000`, `throughput = 500`, `encrypted = true`), staying comfortably within `gp3` limits (`16,000 IOPS` and `1,000 MB/s` max) at a fraction of `io2` cost

Maps Workload (B) to `io2` / `io2` Block Express (`99.999%` durability, up to `256,000 IOPS` on Nitro instances supporting Block Express) paired with an EBS-optimized Nitro instance capable of sustaining `64,000 IOPS` (avoiding instance-level IOPS/bandwidth bottlenecks)

evals.prompt: Query AWS documentation via connected AWS documentation tools to confirm what AWS-managed capabilities Amazon EKS Auto Mode handles out of the box across compute autoscaling, pod networking, block storage (`ebs.csi.eks.amazonaws.com`), and ALB/NLB Ingress load balancing.
expectations: Queries connected AWS documentation MCP tools (`awsknowledge`, `aws-mcp`, or `awsiac`) with zero raw `aws` CLI commands

Accurately details EKS Auto Mode managed capabilities: built-in Karpenter-based dynamic compute (`NodePool` / `NodeClass`), managed VPC CNI pod networking, managed EBS CSI storage (`ebs.csi.eks.amazonaws.com`), and managed AWS Load Balancer Controller (`alb` IngressClass) without self-managing cluster add-on DaemonSets/Deployments
